summary: Teaches how to create a read-only user and add/configure/test a PostgreSQL data source in Grafana Cloud, then query it in Explore.

needs.description: Reachable PostgreSQL server (9.0+) with database "grafana", user "grafanareader" with SELECT privileges, and sample tables to query. Steps fill host localhost:5432, which is not reachable from Grafana Cloud, so a publicly reachable or PDC-reachable instance is needed for Save & test to pass.
needs.evidence: configure-datasource: host=localhost:5432, database=grafana, user=grafanareader; Before you begin: "A PostgreSQL server (version 9.0 or newer) that's up and running"

needs.description: Running PDC agent and a private network entry, only if the PostgreSQL instance is on a private network (test-connection highlights the PDC network select).
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "Created a private connection ... with the PDC agent running, if your database is on a private network"

needs.description: Test user with Grafana Admin / Organization administrator role on the stack

reviewNotes: Steps type localhost:5432 / grafanareader; a real E2E pass needs a Cloud-reachable Postgres and the password supplied out-of-band. Save & test will fail against localhost from Cloud.
